title: Minor-Order Exponent Profiles of Oscillatory Matrices
summary: For an $n\times n$ oscillatory matrix $A$, let $e_k(A)$ be the least positive integer $m$ for which every minor of order $k$ of $A^m$ is positive. We determine the profile $(e_1(A),\ldots,e_n(A))$. For every nonsingular totally nonnegative matrix, the column index sets of positive entries in each compound row form an interval in the componentwise order. The endpoint maps are order-preserving and compose under multiplication. This yields a two-corner criterion for positivity of all minors of a fixed order.
